  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information

  list                  List pipelines and print them as a JSON array
  runs                  List pipeline runs, newest first, and print them as a JSON array

  cancel <runId>        Cancel a pipeline run and print it to stdout as JSON
  retry <runId>         Rerun the failed jobs of a pipeline run and print it to stdout as JSON
  tests <runId>         List the test runs of a pipeline run and print them as a JSON array

Description:
  Create a work item under a parent and print it to stdout as JSON

Usage:
  quill wi create [options]

Options:
  --type <type> (REQUIRED)               Work item type: Feature, Product Backlog Item, Bug, Task. Case-insensitive.
  --title <title> (REQUIRED)             Title for the new work item.
  --parent <parent> (REQUIRED)           The parent work item ID.
  --description-file <description-file>  Path to a markdown file with the description. Pass - to read stdin.
  --assignee <assignee>                  Name of the user to assign the work item to. Defaults to unassigned.
  --tag <tag>                            Tag for the new work item. Repeat for more than one.
  --predecessor <predecessor>            ID of a work item that must be done before this one. Repeat for more than one.
  -?, -h, --help                         Show help and usage information

Options:
  --with-results       Add a results array to each test run, with message and stack trace.
  --outcome <outcome>  Test result outcome, for example Failed or Passed. Repeat for more. Replaces the default Failed. Passed to the server as is. Needs --with-results. [default: Failed]
  --limit <limit>      Maximum number of results per test run. Needs --with-results.
  --skip <skip>        Number of results to skip per test run. Needs --with-results.
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information
